name: Windows MSVC CMake CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: [ x64 ]  # use amd64, x86, amd64_arm64 as needed

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Configure VS developer environment
        uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@v1
        with:
          arch: ${{ matrix.arch }}

      - name: Install CMake + Ninja
        uses: lukka/get-cmake@latest
        with:
          ninja: true

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: cmake -S . -B build -G "Ninja" -A ${{ matrix.arch }} -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config Release
